#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Recover the exact metric delta and replay using a reconstructed NONLOCAL parent."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64,lzma,json,hashlib,sys,subprocess
assert __debug__
assert len(sys.argv)==4,'Usage: RECOVER_C384_METRIC.py PARENT_SOURCE NEW_SOURCE NEW_PROOF'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
DATA=''
enc=DATA.encode();assert len(enc)==10416 and sha(enc)=='04d788ed34383b8f108cf42a8a67aa4a49d5233f084e3531944af5511f3ba0fe'
b=base64.b64decode(enc,validate=True);assert len(b)==7812 and sha(b)=='0c91f9e9c9152c4658d76ec79066ddcde97e56e5d2d0c712d3356c25d4b25e47'
b=lzma.decompress(b);assert len(b)==22360 and sha(b)=='f4fd70e47db17d3f2d4a1d304e1f32d3104a32cf730074795a8a6522d554cc2e'
files=json.loads(b);out=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name,text in files.items():
 p=out/name;assert out in p.resolve().parents;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(text.encode())
for name,r in json.loads(files['MANIFEST.json']).items():
 b=(out/name).read_bytes();assert len(b)==r['bytes'] and sha(b)==r['sha256'],name
print('METRIC_DELTA_LITERAL_SOURCE_MANIFEST_PASS',len(files),flush=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-S',str(out/'REPLAY_METRIC.py'),str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()),str(Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve())],check=True)
